props.gloss_en: the mishnah: on Shavuot [the distributor] says to him: here is matza for you, here is chametz for you
Rav: [one says the blessing of] the sukkah, and afterwards [the blessing of] the time
Rabba bar bar Chana: the time, and afterwards the sukkah
Rav: the obligation of the day takes precedence
Rabba bar bar Chana: of the frequent and the infrequent, the frequent precedes
(entertained) Rav and Rabba bar bar Chana dispute in the dispute of Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel
Beit Shammai: one blesses over the day and afterwards blesses over the wine
Beit Hillel: one blesses over the wine and afterwards blesses over the day
Beit Shammai: for the day causes the wine to come
Beit Shammai: and the day is already sanctified while the wine has not yet come
Beit Hillel: for the wine causes the kiddush to be said
Beit Hillel, another reason: the wine blessing is frequent and the day's is not; of frequent and infrequent, the frequent precedes
Rav: Beit Hillel said [wine first] there only because the wine causes the kiddush to be said
Rav: but here -- were there no blessing of time, would we not say the sukkah blessing?
Rabba bar bar Chana: Beit Shammai said [the day first] there only because the day causes the wine to come
Rabba bar bar Chana: but here -- were there no sukkah, would we not say the blessing of time?
the stam: here [on Shavuot] the chametz is primary and the matza secondary
Abba Shaul: here is chametz for you, here is matza for you

challenges.gloss_en: תנן: בעצרת אומר לו הילך מצה הילך חמץ -- and here, where chametz is primary and matza secondary, it teaches matza first: תיובתא דרב

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר לך רב: תנאי היא -- דתניא: הילך מצה הילך חמץ; אבא שאול אומר: הילך חמץ הילך מצה. The mishnah's order is one side of a tannaitic dispute (m_hilach), so it does not refute Rav

rulings.gloss_en: והלכתא: סוכה, ואחר כך זמן -- the redactor rules with Rav, against Rav Nachman bar Rav Chisda's דרש; coherent with the blunted teyuvta. Verdict-inert.
